answer: Trust transfers at epoch boundary T+90 when an agent deposits nectar into a canyon timelock contract binding its identity hash to one inlet port on the ledger. The contract emits a single trust token at that timestamp, then destroys the deposit slot. Re-entry returns null because the inlet port seals permanently. Sybil clones lack work history before T+90, so they cannot forge that timestamped commitment. Trust moved once; the slot is gone.
